subject.title: [security] Islo API redirects can leave the configured credential destination

question: Should Crabbox treat the documented provider redirect destination rule as applying to Islo SDK and raw HTTP requests and prioritize an Islo guard fix?
rationale: The code/docs evidence supports an in-scope credential-destination boundary issue, but maintainers should own security severity and disclosure handling before implementation proceeds.

options.title: Fix Islo redirect confinement
options.body: Treat this as an in-scope security boundary and land a guarded Islo client plus focused regression tests.

options.title: Adjust severity only
options.body: Keep the issue open but revise severity if maintainers confirm Islo or Go redirect behavior narrows practical exposure.

options.title: Reject the boundary interpretation
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide Islo custom endpoints are intentionally outside the documented provider redirect rule.

recommendation.title: Fix Islo redirect confinement
recommendation.body: Treat this as an in-scope security boundary and land a guarded Islo client plus focused regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history on Islo, provider redirect hardening, and repository security boundary documentation.
